metadata.title: Calabi metric on the space of k-Hessian potentials
metadata.abstract: Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$, and let $1\leq k\leq n$. We consider the space of smooth $k$-admissible potentials introduced in the study of the Hessian-cscK equation by Guo--Smith--Tong. The complex $k$-Hessian equation identifies this space, modulo constants, with the space of smooth positive densities of fixed total mass. We compute the differential of the Hessian density map and use it to pull back the Fisher--Rao metric. The resulting Riemannian metric is \[ G^{\HC,k}_{\varphi}(u,v) =\int_X \bigl(\Delta_{\varphi}^{(k)}u\bigr) \bigl(\Delta_{\varphi}^{(k)}v\bigr) \,\omega_{\varphi}^{k}\wedge\omega^{n-k}. \] We then show that the square-root Hessian density map \[ \varphi\longmapsto 2\sqrt{\frac{\omega_{\varphi}^{k}\wedge\omega^{n-k}}{\omega^n}} \] is a global Riemannian isometry onto the positive part of the $L^2(X,\omega^n)$-sphere of radius $2\sqrt{V}$, where $V=\int_X\omega^n$. For $k=n$, this recovers the spherical description of the classical Calabi metric. We also derive the curvature, geodesic and diameter formulas, and prove a quantitative local comparison between adjacent Hessian--Fisher distances.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 势空间度量的球面表示
analysis.workSummary: 在紧 Kähler 流形的 k-admissible 势空间上通过 Hessian 密度映射拉回 Fisher–Rao 度量，证明平方根密度把模常数势空间整体等距到半径 2√V 的 L2 球面正部分，并给出曲率、测地线、直径及相邻 Hessian 距离的局部比较。
analysis.breakthrough: 把经典 k=n 的 Calabi 度量球面描述推广至一般 k-Hessian 势空间。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。对象为光滑 admissible 势与固定质量的正密度；摘要未讨论弱势空间完备化或奇异密度边界。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 按与几何研究的关联、结论范围和可迁移方法安排阅读；对象为光滑 admissible 势与固定质量的正密度；摘要未讨论弱势空间完备化或奇异密度边界。
